Если сейчас очень плохо: If things are really bad right now
de-press.co — тихая гавань, но это не эк: de-press.co is a quiet harbour, but it is not emergency help. If you are in danger or having thoughts of harming yourself — seek help right now. You don't have to cope alone.
112 — единый номер экстренных служб, 103: 112 is the universal emergency number, 103 is an ambulance (in some countries). Both work from any phone, including one with no credit.
Что можно сделать прямо сейчас: What you can do right now
Скажи живому человеку рядом — даже прост: Tell a live person nearby — even just “I feel awful”. You don't have to explain everything: one sentence is enough to not be left alone.
Позвони 112 или 103 и скажи, что тебе ну: Call 112 or 103 and say that you need help.
Оставайся не один: попроси кого-то быть: Don't stay alone: ask someone to stay with you until help arrives.
Если можешь — убери от себя то, чем можн: If you can — move away from anything you could hurt yourself with, and stay away from dangerous places.
Дыши медленно: вдох на четыре счёта, выд: Breathe slowly: in for four counts, out for six. It doesn't solve everything, but it helps you survive the acute wave.
В de-press.co нет лайков, рейтингов и пу: de-press.co has no likes, ratings or public comments. Your story will be heard, not judged. Only you can start a chat. The AI assistant is always labelled, makes no diagnoses and never replaces people.
Если тяжело давно: If it has been hard for a long time
de-press.co — не медицина и не замена те: de-press.co is not medicine and not a replacement for therapy. If the state lasts for weeks or interferes with living — see a doctor or a psychotherapist. Asking for help is normal.
